packages.question: phase law of the full-game optimum as q -> infinity
packages.headline: primal converges uniformly at rate C/q in certified rational intervals (q*sup|e| bounded and decreasing, inside the derived C at every sampled eta); max/limit exchange verified; t_end = g^2/(4 mu^2 log2) + 1/(2 log2) reproduced to 3e-7.  BUT the binding dual orbit is ALWAYS (s,t,b) = (2,0,0), its slack decays like 1/q (q*slack converges), and it CHANGES SIGN: T_c(1/4) in (1.5, 2] against t_end = 3.967, T_c(2/5) in (0.75, 1] against t_end = 1.533.  So the scalar+pair certificate has a boundary strictly BELOW t_end, and t_end is NOT the phase boundary of the full game.
packages.status: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE (certified rational intervals for the primal and the charges; grid sup over eta)

packages.question: error exponent of safe decision vs full recovery
packages.headline: two finite-N two-sided brackets pin BOTH prefactors; exponents -log(1-sum p) vs -log(1-min p) follow from the brackets, not from a fitted slope; sample-complexity ratio grows like log(1-p_min)/log(1-s)
packages.status: PROVED (pointwise loss sandwich, Lean, 8 audits) + NUMERICAL EVIDENCE (brackets verified on 4 configurations x 8 values of N)

packages.question: does the average/execution gap grow with b?
packages.headline: YES, linearly, and it SATURATES the universal bound: an explicit family g_m = (-3, -1^ceil((m-2)/2), +1^floor((m-2)/2), 3) has eps_nest = 2/(m+4), V_avg = 2/((m+4)(m-1)), ratio = m-1 = b exactly, for m = 5..14; exhaustive search shows b is also the best ratio at every m <= 7; concatenation does NOT amplify
packages.status: PROVED (the two bounds and the saturation lemma, Lean, 6 audits) + exact rational computation of the family

packages.question: when does setup cost change the design topology?
packages.headline: the brief's Gamma_complete and Gamma_star are UNIFORM-allocation values, not the sup over w: the true Gamma of the complete graph is 2-sqrt3 at K=3 and 3/16 at K=4, and the star at the TOP arm reaches the brief's Gamma_complete with K-1 edges; the frontier over T/kappa has 2 regimes at K=3 and 3 at K=4; the fully optimised SYMMETRIC baseline is never beaten (gain 0.000%); realising a contrast as two scalar reads DOES change the winner to cells
packages.status: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE (convex solver, floating point; supports read at a tolerance)

packages.question: how far does the h^4 law survive measurement error?
packages.headline: all three regimes confirmed: KL/h^4 -> (1/2)||lambda A + B||^2 for eps = lambda h at 6 values of lambda, KL ~ (1/2)||A||^2 h^2 eps^2 for h << eps, and the Gram determinant is 5.87e-8 > 0 so the worst-case coefficient inf_lambda is 7.335e-5 > 0
packages.status: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE (exact rational construction; float64 quadrature with a stabilised integrand and a refinement check)

packages.question: when must a GROUP of calibration queries be bought?
packages.headline: rank >= 2 in the nuisance is NECESSARY (rank-one G admits no complementarity, proved) and SUFFICIENT (a four-item/two-instrument family gives G = 3 V_0 . I_2 from real query means: each control alone moves the value by exactly -V_0, the pair by +V_0/2); full-class optimum in closed form V = 3(3-2 sqrt2)/32 = (18-12 sqrt2) V_0 with a dual tight on every ordinary query and every control
packages.status: PROVED (the rank dichotomy, Lean, 5 audits) + NUMERICAL EVIDENCE (the construction and the full-class certificate, floating point)
